$comment: Fact registry for docs-lint Rule 2 (intra-page contradiction), issue #2865.
Each entry names a single high-value fact. Rule 2 asserts that any one documentation
page states AT MOST ONE distinct value for it. A page that disagrees with itself is a
hard failure: a reader has no way to tell which half is true, so the whole page - and by
extension the docset - stops being trustworthy.
id       - stable identifier, reported on failure.
defect   - the specific defect from the 2026-08-07 DOC-FINDINGS.md batch this entry
exists to prevent. Required by AC7: every rule cites its motivating defect.
pattern  - .NET/PowerShell regex with a named capture group 'value'. Every match on a
normalize  - optional: 'lower' | 'none'. Defaults 'lower' so 'True' and 'true' are one
value; set 'none' when the fact IS the casing (see configKeyCasing).

facts.defect: cron-and-scheduling.md gave tickIntervalSeconds as 60 in a table and 10 in a diagram.
getting-started-release.md sent every new user to port 18790 while the gateway binds 5005.
$scoping: Deliberately NOT a bare localhost:<port> match. A docs page legitimately quotes many
loopback ports belonging to OTHER processes - Ollama 11434, Jaeger 16686, an OTLP
collector 4317, a sample reverse proxy on 8080. Flagging those as a self-contradiction
would be false and would train readers to ignore the gate. The fact is specifically
'which port does the BotNexus gateway/portal listen on', so the match requires gateway,
portal or botnexus wording on the same line as the URL.

facts.defect: heartbeat ownership/cadence was stated twice with different numbers.
